messages:
niko: Quick catch in api-ref/requests.md — the curl example sends a response header `X-Request-Id: abc123` but the Python snippet reads `resp.json()['requestId']`. We should standardize on header vs body and on casing (snake_case vs camelCase).

elena: thanks, which canonical shape do we want? Runtime emits `X-Request-Id` header and the JSON body uses `request_id` (snake_case) currently for internal consistency. Looks like the docs drifted to camelCase in the SDK snippets.

pradeep: runtime team confirms canonical: header `X-Request-Id` (Pascal-case) and body field `request_id` (snake_case). Both are stable. SDK idiomatic clients may expose helpers that map to camelCase on the client object, but docs must reflect the wire formats.

niko: ok — plan: update examples so curl uses header `X-Request-Id: <id>` and all JSON examples show "request_id": "abc123". Add a short note: "Note: the SDK client maps request_id -> requestId in returned objects for JS and Java clients."

elena: also fix the Python snippet which currently has:```python
resp = requests.get(url)
print(resp.headers.get('x-request-id'))
print(resp.json()['requestId'])
```
Change to:```python
resp = requests.get(url)
print(resp.headers.get('X-Request-Id'))
print(resp.json()['request_id'])
```
And add a language hint on the codeblocks.

pradeep: docs CI will complain if OpenAPI examples don't match. I can open a tiny openapi PR to ensure examples show `request_id` in responses and keep header listed under common-headers.

docs-bot: linked PRs: docs https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/960 , openapi https://github.com/redwood-inference/openapi/pull/345 . Docs CI: failed (example-schema-check).

elena: failing because the SDK snippet still referenced `requestId`. @pradeep can you add a note in the openapi response examples to include both forms in a short remark? Maybe better: response example uses canonical `request_id`; the SDK snippets will be changed separately.

pradeep: created sdk-snippets PR to update python/js examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-snippets/pull/711 — swaps `requestId` -> `request_id` in wire-format examples and adds a comment that high-level SDK objects may present camelCase. SDK CI: failing (snippet-presence test).

elena: docs PR updated to include a migration note: "Docs now show the wire formats: header X-Request-Id and body field request_id (snake_case). Some SDKs expose camelCase wrappers (requestId) — check language-specific SDK docs for transformations." Also added codeblock language hints. Pushed.

docs-bot: Docs CI re-run: passing. sdk-snippets PR re-run: passing. openapi PR CI: passing.

niko: thanks! final ask: add CHANGELOG entry: "requests: standardized wire-format examples to X-Request-Id header and request_id JSON body field; SDKs may present camelCase mappings."

elena: added changelog line and merged. :shipit:

pradeep: filed INF-1470 to track a runtime proxy change to normalize header casing for older clients; no immediate breaking changes.

niko: all good. closing loop and notifying support so they don't triage `requestId` tickets as server bug.

docs-bot: merged PRs and updated staging docs.
